title: TRAK — master checklist

release.native: Regular TRAK 476 is available in internal TestFlight. It adds the approved widget polish, P/F/C order, wide Search and four actions, Android widget loading/settings repairs, and confirmed diary/target refresh. All 18 staging groups and the production work already delivered in 475 are retained. Both signed packages pass verification. Matching Android 476 is prepared for the established manual Firebase upload; this task has not uploaded it to Firebase. Staging 45 remains unchanged.
release.backend: Production backend 2722 is live and independently verified. The two-table serving-calculation migration is applied, read back and safe to rerun. Current native-contract searches return complete View all data; paired ordered results match the baseline. Server timing passes; Mac transport outliers are recorded separately and do not establish phone or VPN speed.
release.next: Update regular TRAK to 476 in TestFlight. Aadam handles the established Android APK upload and checks Pixel 9 widget picker/add/refresh behavior. Astra handles reported regressions and maintains the checklist. Public store release and physical widget acceptance are separate; previously accepted graph and maintenance evidence need not be repeated.

notes: Public, read-only project status. No login needed.
Historical checks are retained separately; a new regression is not closed by an older sign-off.
Updates appear here after the shared checklist is published. Local edits and chat messages do not update it.
Reconciled through 10 September. Released changes, local fixes and reported phone results are tracked separately. This board update does not release a TRAK app build.

changes.text: Regular TRAK 476 is available in internal TestFlight, with matching signed Android prepared for manual upload. All widget designs were approved and implemented, including P/F/C 2x2 order, wide Search/actions, continuous ring fill, Android loading/settings and confirmed diary/target refresh. Full tests and native renders pass; Pixel picker and phone observations remain separately tracked. All 18 prior staging groups are retained.

Android widget loading repair passes all six native layouts locally. Shared widget data/account/day-state repairs have regression coverage. Small Macros polish is approved; all other widget previews are ready for design review. No new app build is distributed; Android configuration, final combined builds and phone acceptance remain.

Added a deferred iPhone Duo design and compatibility review, covering folded/unfolded layouts, Split View, state preservation, charts, editors and widgets. Apple’s announcement was checked; no TRAK implementation or new release is included.

Widget review found a reproducible Android Build 475 loading failure plus layout and setup gaps. Five of six released Android layouts fail the actual widget renderer. Recorded Pixel 9 picker-search report separately. No application code or release changed.
Queued widget layout improvements for later, starting with the small Macros widget on iOS. Android layout review remains separate; no app changes or new release were made.

Manual production release complete for backend 2722 and regular TRAK 475 internal TestFlight. All 18 staging groups are included with newer production work preserved; matching Android APK is signed and prepared for manual Firebase upload. Food-read recovery, immediate Recipe Edit and the Android small Today shortcut cleanup are included.
Production backend 2722 is live and verified. App-request Search timing passes in UK and US checks, with full View all data and unchanged result ordering. Native Build 475 is compiling and signing.

Manual production release started: the independently verified serving-calculation migration is complete, backend 2722 is deploying, and native Build 475 is running its signed release gate. The existing manual release rule applies; the earlier hosted-check blocker is removed.

Corrected the release document format that caused the visual release page to show a loading error. Added a validation check for the page reader’s required section order. All 18 groups and the final integration results are retained.

All 18 staging groups are integrated with newer production work preserved. The combined app passes 4,261 current sign-in tests and 122 older sign-in tests; backend and real database checks also pass. Food-nutrient recovery and immediate recipe Edit are included. Unsigned iOS compilation passes. Hosted checks cannot currently start, and the two additive serving-calculation tables remain unapplied. Production is unchanged.

Build 45 graph rendering and edge correction is accepted on the phone. Fresh production review found newer widget picker and recipe source-amount persistence work. The prior file inventory needs reconciliation before a combined production release; no production deployment was made.

Build 45 is installed directly with saved preferences unchanged. It fixes current-profile shading coverage, the extra older day affecting bar scale, and reference edges while retaining normal motion. All 4,296 app tests and signed-artifact checks pass; six rendered regressions fail on the previous source and pass with the fix. Internal TestFlight availability is now confirmed. The inventory now covers 443 native and 142 backend/repository paths; the newer regular app Build 473 is preserved.

Build 44 is installed directly and launches, with saved preferences unchanged. It restores the normal graph transition while preserving prior staging changes. It is also available in internal TestFlight. Phone feedback reports delayed shading/bars and an outer-edge gap; these are actively being fixed. The release inventory now covers 439 native and 142 backend/repository paths, protecting newer production widget configuration and backend 2717 recipe source amounts. The release evidence retains two intermittent full-run sync-test failures and the passing baseline/candidate reruns.

Nutrient graphs: the user rejected Build 43’s faster slide. The next-build correction restores the standard screen transition without undoing data preparation or caching; 97 focused checks pass. Not built/uploaded yet.

The release inventory is now a complete visual page: 18 staging change groups with their remaining checks, unfinished fixes and production protections. Open Staging → production above the checklist. The previous shared anchor now opens this full view.

Build 43 is available in internal TestFlight and backend 2721 is verified live. Graph preparation, cache retention and the 200ms slide fix reproduced delays; Coach draws a continuous tick; iodine is recognised by the shared backend. All 4,290 app tests and signed-artifact checks pass. The promotion ledger now covers 572 differing tracked paths and retains all earlier staging groups and newer production protections. This staging release did not deploy production. The inventory also caught the separate production 2716 recipe release and now protects it during future promotion.

Completed the Build 42 graph trace, diagnosed iodine as a shared backend key mismatch, and recorded its tested but undeployed correction. Added the maintained staging-to-production list with 18 change groups, unreleased work, schema/configuration gates and production-only protections. Source inventory covers 559 differing tracked files. Older backend fixture failures remain explicit; no new deployment.

Build 42 phone testing found a tick-animation pause and a remaining roughly half-second graph delay. The tick pause is reproduced and removed locally, with 91 focused Coach checks passing. A new regression item records its pending release. Graph timing and phone acceptance remain open; no new app build or backend deployment.

Build 42 is available in internal TestFlight, paired with verified live backend 2720. It adds Coach Accept feedback, the goal-weight/rate review flow, graph preparation and clearer food loading with diagnostics. All 4,282 complete app checks and signed-artifact checks pass. Fresh staging provisioning is verified. Phone acceptance and the actual food Retry failure remain open.

Staging backend 2720 is deployed and verified. Build 42 is signed and uploading, with the Coach Accept, goal-review and nutrient follow-ups. All 4,282 complete app checks pass, plus signing/configuration checks. Apple processing and phone acceptance remain pending.

Added the reported Coach Accept delay. A local correction starts its animation while saving, then confirms success only after the save completes. Failure recovery, duplicate taps, changed recommendations and the existing Coach flow pass 91 focused checks. It awaits the next staging package and phone acceptance; Build 41 and the live backend are unchanged.

Build 41 phone testing identified missing-data waits behind graph delays, an incomplete goal-rate edit sequence and intermittent Food Editor retries. Goal-flow and initial-loading corrections are local; the graph preparation candidate has passed calculation parity checks. The actual intermittent food failure remains open. No new app or backend release.

Staging Build 41 is available in internal TestFlight. It adds the Edit goal target-return correction, clearer calorie-minimum copy, full-screen food micronutrients with serving captions and blank zeros, and the restored light overview background. The repeated graph-opening delay remains open; local diagnostics are included. Full app suites passed 4,163 current-login and 110 legacy-login checks. Apple accepted this build despite the shared provisioning-profile change; future signing is tracked separately.

The larger recipe-precision pilot reproduced the 400-to-399 loss and produced a one-line local snapshot fix. Four new route cases pass; Astra compared the same four broader test failures against unchanged staging source and retained them. The TDEE benchmark is unchanged. Graft helped with supporting files but missed the backend helper; measured token savings are not established. This new fix is not deployed.

Staging Build 40 is available in internal TestFlight, paired with verified live backend 2719. All five transferred Coach, cycling and nutrient fixes are delivered; phone acceptance remains open. Both complete app suites passed (4,159 current-login and 110 legacy-login checks). The next larger recipe-saving precision pilot has started with a focused reproduction gate and measured Graft use. Production was not changed.

Added the approved first-use feature guides at the top of Planned work. The light and dark designs cover micronutrient bars, nutrition history, multi-food logging and Trend versus Scale weight. Quick Actions is excluded because it is being removed. This is a design record only; no app implementation or release is claimed.

Astra reviewed and integrated the five transferred Coach/nutrient follow-ups locally. Review replaced a copied-save test with the real cycling settings journey and caught stale-owner and later-edit cases. The EPA + DHA backend/app contract now agrees on incomplete data. An inherited feature-flag visual-test gap was identified against unchanged Build 39 and corrected with separate baselines; no new native build or EPA backend deployment is claimed. Both complete app test runs now pass: 4,159 current-login checks and 110 legacy-login checks. Graft repository mapping is installed and connected to Codex for agent navigation.

Staging backend 2718 is deployed with the reviewed recipe-unlink precision fix and verified live. Staging Build 39 is now distributed. Astra has taken over the remaining Coach sequencing, cycling-target refresh, nutrient loading/rail presentation and EPA + DHA companion work; the new native fixes and EPA + DHA backend remain unreleased.

Implementation pilot: a targeted recipe-unlink precision fix is reviewed locally. Earlier recipe-saving rounding and two pre-existing automated-test failures remain open. No staging or production app release was made.

Staging Build 39 is built and signed locally with planner, cycling-target, Coach animation and nutrient presentation corrections. Its artifact identity was independently checked. Upload, distribution, companion backend deployment and phone acceptance remain outstanding; this checklist publication does not release the app.

A focused Coach handoff audit found the board behind the release evidence: Staging Build 38 is distributed and backend 2717 already carries the accepted maintenance policy. The Build 37 test-button URL failure is corrected in Build 38, with phone acceptance still open. Broader Coach effectiveness and production promotion remain separate.

Maintenance decision behavior is accepted using the independently reviewed simulations. The proposed extra phone exercise with prepared weight histories is removed. Backend integration and ordinary release checks remain; this checklist change does not deploy the policy.

The maintenance policy is now implemented and independently reviewed locally: selected ranges, sustained drift and fewer small calorie changes improve measured outcomes. A noisier first version was rejected. Full effectiveness and staging/phone acceptance remain separate. The release owner also confirmed Build 37 and its paired staging backend contain the earlier Coach fixes and test-cycle controls, not this new policy.

The maintenance investigation reproduced all 34 journeys and traced the 14 small lower-range misses to the transition into maintenance and gradual corrections. Longer observation improved the count but did not resolve all misses. A range-only change made results worse and was removed; no app release occurred.

Sol completed the goal-history repair and the expanded post-goal simulation, with independent review. Plan transitions passed, maintenance outcomes still need investigation, and the selected maintenance range differs from the current adjustment trigger. These Coach changes remain local; full sign-off is open.

Staging Build 34 is available in internal TestFlight with the All-range, target-marker, weight-unit and calculator-serving fixes, retaining Build 33 Search diagnostics. Phone acceptance remains open. Coach repairs and repeat-check-in controls are not in Build 34.

Coach completion investigation found and verified earlier goal-completion work. The outcome simulation omits choosing a next plan; its existing failed score remains visible. A separate earlier-history edge case is recorded, and Coach test controls are explicitly excluded from Build 34.

Staging Build 33 is available in internal TestFlight with staging backend 2714. The Mac restart cleared the packaging blocker. The build retains earlier nutrient-range retry work and adds Search connection diagnostics; the VPN stall is still open.

The next staging candidate has local fixes for the short-history All range, faint target markers and shared body-weight unit conversion. Calculator serving memory is also tested locally and handed over for integration. These changes are not in Build 33.
Reconciled this shared board with release records, current work and issues since 3 September. Historical sign-offs remain historical; pending phone checks were not marked complete.

Coach review, target-consistency and personal-minimum repairs are implemented locally, with staging controls to repeat a check-in immediately. The broader outcome comparison still fails its improvement gate; staging/backend release and phone acceptance remain open.

The catalogue audit found successful nightly maintenance but unreliable recent grocery triggers and no established daily full-source OFF/USDA sync. Source freshness and reliable completion records are now explicit tasks.

Recent flagged-food catalogue repairs were verified live, including a later per-burger correction. The broader all-region evidence safeguard remains local, and AI model comparisons need reproducible unseen evaluation.

Regular Builds 469/470 and production backend 2714 delivered the selected goal, nutrient, Search and Health work. Build 470 corrected the native feature default; backend 2715 then repaired the production coverage endpoint. Phone acceptance and separate nutrient defects remain open.

Staging Build 28 introduced native Search transport work. A whole-egg query through a USA VPN later stalled despite a quick server response; subsequent uncached food checks were quick. The extreme delay was not fully explained.

Staging Builds 29/30 added nutrient presentation changes and weight units before named food portions. Later range fixes addressed response ordering and retries, but phone testing still found the short-history 1Y-to-All case.

Reviewed backend security work was deployed and retained by the selected production release. A separate signed-artifact promotion gate was added locally; internal distribution is not public-store acceptance.

Staging Builds 21–27 advanced cold nutrient loading, Search speed and diagnostic work while retaining prior changes. The early Build 22 backend pairing gap was resolved. Later phone findings drove further fixes rather than closing the whole feature.

Staging Builds 16–20 added current-goal weight/rate editing, target cards and further food-editor and nutrient corrections. The post-Build-468 review also addressed View all, serving layout, stale projections and recurring-add first paint.

The later Build 468 backend work corrected secondary daily totals, pinned private-food identity and food/recipe projections. Those implementation changes supersede earlier plan-only entries, while cross-surface phone acceptance remains separate.

Aadam confirmed on iPhone that, after hard-closing TRAK Staging Build 15, reopening it and searching immediately, personal and database results showed right away. This accepts the cold first typed-Search case only. Five-second visual stability, View all, repeat-cache, worldwide, recipe, portion and nutrient checks remain open; regular TRAK and production were not changed.

TRAK Staging Build 15 is available to internal iOS testers, with a matching signed Android file ready for manual Firebase upload. It adds compact first-page catalogue Search, explicit View all loading, a bounded per-account exact-query cache and stable personal sections while retaining the existing staging nutrient and Raw Chicken work. Automated checks are recorded privately; phone acceptance remains open and production was not changed.

Staging Build 14 failed two new phone checks: catalogue and TRAK Custom results lagged behind local results, and Raw Chicken had no portion chips. The staging Fast index had not been enabled and the Custom Search response omitted reviewed source metadata. A backend-only correction is now healthy on staging and passes live timing and payload checks; the same installed staging app still needs phone acceptance. Production was not changed.

TRAK Staging Build 14 is available to internal testers. It combines the existing Cronometer nutrient work with the Search first-paint and stable-results correction, shared recipe servings and preserved AI recipe identity. The combined staging backend is healthy. Regular TRAK and production were not changed.

Installed regular Build 467 remains affected: a cold chicken breast Search took about two seconds, Previously logged and My foods could continue appearing afterward, and a recently logged recipe could lose its named serving and show grams. Staging Build 14 is the candidate correction, not a verified-live fix.

The food-projection audit now has an executable source-of-truth matrix, identical cross-path fixtures and parity tests. It confirmed that some secondary calorie consumers still bypass the canonical entries-versus-food-log daily-total rule; that remediation remains separate and open.

Build 464 is installed on iPhone and partially failed phone acceptance: the first Search open after updating still waited for Suggested and Recents; Food Editor changed shape after opening and did not update the Nutrition basis from the TRAK number pad; safe logout used a centred dialog; and Delete Undo waited for sync. Stay signed in passed. Local follow-up corrections are tested but are not in Build 464.

Typed Search was separately reported slow again on Build 464. No exact query or Fast-versus-Full timing has been captured, so this remains an open diagnosis and is not claimed fixed by the empty-Search shelf correction.

Build 464 was built and signed locally for iOS and Android from one tested source. It includes the Search and recurring cold-open corrections, exact serving-choice retention for pending or offline logs, and refined iPhone inactive-state diagnostics. It was subsequently uploaded to TestFlight and installed on iPhone; its partial phone results are recorded above.

The Build 463 missing-Recents issue is corrected in the live backend. Suggested habits no longer block recent non-habit foods from the current meal, and the shelves cannot duplicate a card. No new phone build is needed; close and reopen Search to verify.

New Search issue confirmed after installing Build 463: Suggested can appear while the Recents shelf is absent. Recents are currently narrowed to the clock slot, and their meal-period fallback is blocked whenever Suggested has a card.

Build 463 is valid in TRAK's internal TestFlight group and is now installed on iPhone. Its backend and database companion are live. The matching Android build is signed and Aadam is uploading it to Firebase. Recurring-transition and food-editor acceptance remain open.

Recurring transitions and the serving/unit/icon editor are implemented, combined and reviewed locally. Final tests pass: 3,717 native, 108 legacy-login and 630 backend tests. The three final review defects are repaired; one minor empty-panel metadata follow-up remains. Backend/schema release, a new phone build and device checks are still required. Not in Build 462.

Build 462 is available in TestFlight for internal testers; Apple processing and beta availability are verified. The matching Android file is ready for Firebase. Installation and phone acceptance remain open.

Main coordination checkpoint saved for a pause. Build 462 files and release notes are preserved. Resume with delivery and phone checks, address any remaining regression, then serving-size editing. Other work owners are unchanged.

Build 462 signed iPhone and Android files are ready and release tests pass. Includes Search opening, saved-library visibility, recurring refresh and safe logout. Upload, installation and phone acceptance remain; these issues are not marked resolved.
Search opening: a local native correction removes a disk-cache wait that can hold ready Suggested/Recents cards. A new phone build and timing check remain; the wider idle freeze is not closed.
Reconciled the latest handoff: copy work is paused; reference-food publication and source-inventory review remain open.
Published the shared, no-login master checklist with current issues, unreleased fixes and earlier sign-offs separated.
Deployed the upcoming-slot recurring correction; phone acceptance remains.
Search History and recurring additions confirmed working on phone.
Library filtering, recurring return refresh and safe logout corrected in the unreleased native candidate.

tasks.title: Fix Android widgets showing “Can’t load widget”
tasks.summary: The loading repair is included in Build 476, available in internal TestFlight with matching release-signed Android prepared for manual upload. All 12 widget layouts and 224 debug render states pass; the exact signed release also passes 56 populated cases through a real widget host; released 475 failed five original layouts. Four providers and per-widget settings are included. Pixel 9 picker-search and physical add/refresh acceptance remain separate from emulator evidence.
tasks.nextStep: Aadam distributes the prepared Android 476 through the established manual route, then confirms the widgets appear, add and refresh on Pixel 9. Astra owns any remaining launcher or widget failure. Do not describe the Pixel report as resolved until that observation is confirmed.

tasks.title: Draw complete nutrient graphs and align target-range edges
tasks.summary: Build 45 corrects incomplete Standard shading and a chart-window mismatch that allowed older history to change the visible bars and scale. Target and range segments now meet the plot edges while historical Custom gaps remain unknown. It is installed directly; internal TestFlight availability is confirmed. All six rendered regressions pass, as does the full app suite. Phone feedback on 10 September confirms the reported graph fix looks good. The accepted corrections are also included in regular TRAK 475.
tasks.nextStep: Astra preserves the accepted graph fix, historical Custom gaps and standard motion in future work. No repeated test is required solely because it was promoted.

tasks.title: Match nutrient graph transitions to the other screens
tasks.summary: Build 45 retains the Build 44 correction: it removes the special 200 ms graph animation and uses the same standard screen transition as the rest of Insights. Earlier data preparation, cached history and swipe-back are preserved. Retained in regular TRAK 475, available in internal TestFlight.
tasks.nextStep: Regular TRAK 475 is available in internal TestFlight and retains the normal Insights transition. Staging 45 remains the directly installed build; its accepted graph result is retained. Astra owns any new motion feedback.

tasks.title: Staging changes awaiting production
tasks.summary: All 18 staging change groups were delivered in regular TRAK 475 and remain included in 476, now available in internal TestFlight. Build 476 additionally contains the approved widget polish and repairs. Production backend 2722 is unchanged. Both signed packages pass verification; matching Android 476 is prepared for the existing manual Firebase upload. New phone acceptance and public App Store release are separate.
tasks.nextStep: Astra maintains this delivery record and handles regressions. Update regular TRAK to 476 in TestFlight; the accepted Build 45 graph result remains valid. Widget-specific Pixel checks stay on their own tasks.

tasks.title: Keep newer production work when promoting staging

It retains widgets and picker corrections, Health weight pickup and Apple Health/Health Connect writes, saved-food cache and icons, AI/voice/recipe/recurring identity and household amounts. Signed artifacts retain production identity, App Groups and Health permissions. Android release lint also caught and corrected six duplicate shortcut rows inherited from the production small Today widget.
tasks.nextStep: Preserve this combined production source for later work. Source, signing and regression evidence is recorded; no new physical Health-write or widget acceptance is inferred.

tasks.title: Promote staging micronutrient changes
tasks.summary: Included in regular TRAK 475 and production backend 2722: nutrient rails, references, legends and precision; EPA+DHA agreement; full-screen food nutrients and serving captions; zero display and light-mode background; complete graph/Today data and navigation guards. Build 45 retains early history preparation and caches, restores normal screen motion and corrects first-frame shading, bar scaling and edges. The reported graph fix has phone sign-off; backend 2721 adds iodine reads.
tasks.nextStep: Promotion is complete for the backend and internal iPhone app. Astra retains feature-specific acceptance and regression records; Android uses the prepared signed APK for the existing manual upload.

tasks.title: Promote staging Coach and goal changes
tasks.summary: Included in regular TRAK 475 and production backend 2722: personal minimum and copy, coherent reviews, maintenance correction and post-goal simulations, immediate daily/cycling targets, goal-weight/rate review editing, unit/slider fixes and Coach loading/Accept feedback. Build 43 includes the continuous tick correction.
tasks.nextStep: Promotion is complete for the backend and internal iPhone app. Astra retains feature-specific acceptance and regression records; Android uses the prepared signed APK for the existing manual upload.

tasks.title: Promote staging Search and food changes
tasks.summary: Included in regular TRAK 475 and production backend 2722: dedicated native iOS search transport and diagnostics; remembered calculator servings; g/oz/lb before named portions; validated food calculations with offline recovery; Add commits the selected-food list; recipe unlink keeps fractional nutrition. Both signed packages pass verification and iOS 475 is available in internal TestFlight.
tasks.nextStep: Promotion is complete for the backend and internal iPhone app. Astra retains feature-specific acceptance and regression records; Android uses the prepared signed APK for the existing manual upload.

tasks.title: Repair older nutrient test-database fixtures
tasks.summary: The repaired test schemas and fixtures are merged with production backend 2722. The combined suite passes 1,826 tests and 348 subtests, with 90 separate real PostgreSQL checks. Ownership, cancellation and transaction assertions are preserved. Verified local equivalents were used under the standing manual release rule; hosted jobs did not execute.
tasks.nextStep: Keep the current fixtures and pinned combined test manifest in future backend work. This repair is complete.

tasks.title: Make iodine graphs load
tasks.summary: Fixed in live staging backend 2721: iodine is recognised across graph history, batch history and breakdowns. The running source matches the tested correction. It reads existing microgram values; missing data stays missing and no recommended target is invented. Focused 101 tests and 174 subtests pass.
tasks.nextStep: Open iodine in TRAK Staging. The backend correction also works with the existing app; Build 43 includes the separate graph-opening improvements. Astra records the phone result.

tasks.title: Keep the Coach acceptance tick smooth
tasks.summary: Build 43 includes the tested correction for the Build 42 tick freeze. The stroke now draws continuously from the tap instead of pausing partway through or restarting after the response. Successful saving still controls confirmation and return; late failure restores the review. Retained in regular TRAK 475, available in internal TestFlight.
tasks.nextStep: Install regular TRAK 475 and accept a Coach review. Check the uninterrupted tick and correctly saved plan; Astra owns any follow-up.
